hero.headline: Every taka you <own>own</own> and <owe>owe</owe>, in one encrypted dashboard.
hero.subheading: Phinio unifies your investment portfolio and loan EMIs into a single, beautifully private view — end-to-end secured and scoped to you alone.

assets.title: One vault for every asset class

features.label: What's inside
features.heading: Two halves of your money, finally in one place.
features.intro: What you own and what you owe have always lived in different apps. Phinio holds both — and shows you the number that actually matters.

portfolio.title: Investment portfolio
portfolio.description: Lump-sum, scheduled DPS, and flexible savings pots under one schema. Returns are computed automatically; exit values record realised P&L.

emi.title: EMI management
emi.description: Bank loans and credit-card EMIs with a full reducing-balance amortization schedule generated upfront — every row stored, never guessed.
bullets: Push reminders before every due date

dashboard.title: Unified dashboard
dashboard.description: One net-worth snapshot — active investment values minus EMI balances — with an interactive allocation donut and upcoming dues at a glance.
bullets: Tap a slice to isolate an asset type

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.heading: From scattered to settled in three steps.

step1.title: Create your encrypted vault
step1.description: Sign up with verified email. Sessions are httpOnly and every query is scoped to you alone.

step2.title: Log what you own & owe
step2.description: Add investments and EMIs once — Phinio builds the schedules and computes returns for you.

step3.title: Watch one number that matters
step3.description: Your net worth updates live, with reminders so a due date never slips past you again.

security.label: Privacy by architecture
security.heading: A vault, not a feed.
security.intro: Phinio never sells, shares, or aggregates your data. Authorization isn't a setting — it's enforced on every single database query, so cross-user leakage is structurally impossible.

scoping.title: Per-query scoping
scoping.description: Every read filters on your profile ID. No exceptions.

sessions.title: Encrypted sessions
sessions.description: httpOnly, secure cookies via Better Auth.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.description: Every create, update & delete is logged.

finalCta.heading: Take your money private.
finalCta.subheading: Open your vault in under a minute. Free to start — your data never leaves your scope.
